ai.title: Default port 4242, lodash peerDeps, build cleanup
ai.summary: Default backend port changed from 3000 to 4242 in `backend/src/server.ts` and `manicode/src/config.ts`. `lodash` moved to `peerDependencies` or wildcard versions across `backend`, `common`, and `manicode` `package.json` files. `manicode` build script simplified to remove redundant `copy-files` step and clean `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`. Root `package.json` adds `lodash` and types to `devDependencies`.

eli5.text: The assistant's backend server now listens on port 4242 by default instead of port 3000, so the development environment and any local connections will use this new port. This affects developers running the project locally, who will notice the change in their browser or client configuration. Additionally, the project management tooling (manicode) had its build process cleaned up to remove a redundant step and clear stale build artifacts. These are behind-the-scenes changes to make development smoother.
